title: A lawsuit has been filed against Central Anadolu News correspondent Cem Özkaya
paragraphs: Central Anadolu News correspondent Cem Özkaya has been indicted for violating the investigation's secrecy due to the details of the corruption investigation.

According to the indictment, Cem Özkaya violated the scope of the investigation with the details of the corruption investigation published on February 11, 2026. The sentence is carried out: the Turkish Penal Code 285 (infringement of the confidentiality of the investigation).
The indictment was approved on 7 April 2026 by Konya 4th Criminal Court. The first hearing will be held on 2 July 2026.
Attorney Tolga Erdem in the Cem Özkaya case has stated that the report is considered a criminal without an expert examination.
Cem Özkaya works as a reporter for the Central Anadolu News broadcaster. Journalists' organisations said the case could have a deterrent effect on freedom of the press.
The prosecutor's office is demanding a one-to-three-year sentence for Cem Özkaya. Cem Özkaya is on trial without arrest.
